user_requirements.statement: The system shall automatically lock active user sessions after 15 minutes of user inactivity.
The system shall record an immutable time-stamped audit trail for any create, modify, or delete action on analytical batch records, capturing user ID, timestamp, old value, and new value.
Electronic signatures must require two distinct identification components (User ID and Password) for non-continuous signing sessions and print the reason for signing.
The system shall perform automated daily incremental backups and weekly full backups with automated checksum verification.

oq_test_scripts.steps: Login as an Analyst user. Leave session idle on the sample run screen for 15 minutes. Verify modal warning displays at 14 minutes and system automatically logs out at 15:01, requiring re-authentication.
oq_test_scripts.expected_result: Session is terminated and no unsaved changes are committed without authentication.

oq_test_scripts.test_title: Batch Result Modification Audit Trail Verification
oq_test_scripts.steps: Open approved batch record #8841. Modify moisture content from 2.4% to 2.5%. Enter required change reason. Inspect audit trail table. Verify old value 2.4%, new value 2.5%, timestamp in UTC, and analyst credentials are logged.
oq_test_scripts.expected_result: Immutable audit record created; database record cannot be overwritten without audit entry.

oq_test_scripts.steps: Attempt to approve deviation report DEV-001. Enter password only. Verify system requires both username and password. Enter signature meaning 'Approval of Technical Content'. Verify PDF export manifests printed name, date, time, and meaning.
oq_test_scripts.expected_result: Dual-credential challenge enforced and signature manifestation conforms to 21 CFR Part 11.50.

oq_test_scripts.steps: Trigger automated cron backup task. Verify snapshot creation in S3 bucket. Compute SHA-256 hash of source database volume vs backup archive. Execute mock restore to test instance.
oq_test_scripts.expected_result: Backup archive integrity verified via SHA-256 matching and mock database restoration succeeds.

oq_test_scripts.steps: Log in with Read-Only Auditor role. Attempt to delete chromatographic method. Verify 'Delete' button is disabled and API call returns 403 Forbidden.
oq_test_scripts.expected_result: Unauthorized actions are blocked per RBAC matrix.
